verdict.why:
I wrote my own classifier from the shape tests as worded and did not import or read ledger.mjs. I ran it over by-source/hiperbiblia_sdbh.jsonl (14,823 routes, 3,659 keys, 4,599 key-and-definition records, all M17).

(a) Counts: every mark total and every shape count matches the draft exactly. That covers '(' 791, ')' 791, "'" 242, '>' 193, '-' 177, ',' 72, '.' 60, '?' 46, '"' 18, '!' 16, '=' 9, ':' 2, '/' 2, '\' 1, '[' 1 and ']' 1. The ';' count is 10,456 between items plus 1 inside parentheses (צהב), counted over the 4,599 records; 3,727 records carry a ';' and no route does. Two tests match only under one reading of their words. 'paren.argument_placeholder' gives 351 only if "holding" means the content contains a placeholder word; content that is exactly a placeholder gives 181 (and qualifier 566). 'q.route_final_interrogative' gives 23 only if "interrogative word" also covers for what, from where, is, really and truly; the usual wh-words alone give 12 and 23. The draft's evidence numbers also reproduce:
- 872 whole, 13,951 slice, 0 absent
- 15,055 items; 14,821 are routes on their own record and 197 on another record of the same key
- 75 commas in the definitions; 733 routes with a parenthesis; 0 nested
- '>' at depth 0: 192, left side a route 79 times, right side 0
- '=' right side a route 0 of 7, left side 1
- parenthesis content is a route on the same key: 5
- 19 routes separated; 1 lone '-' item (את)

(b) Completeness: 0 occurrences fall outside every shape. The tests are first-match in their listed order. Read on their own, they overlap only where copula_elliptic and verb_head_distributed both match (10 commas) and where the "any other" qualifier catch-all overlaps the named parenthesis shapes.

(c) Falsification: I made at least 3 attempts on each dividing shape and found nothing beyond the draft's own stated, counted exceptions.
- semicolon.between_gloss_items: no route fails to be an item. No item reads as an editorial note. 2 bare-verb items follow a 'to' item (נפק: go out / come out), and the store already prints them alone. 1 '-' item is stated by the draft.
- comma.complete_infinitives (4): every piece starts 'to ', every piece is a whole verb rendering, and the pieces rejoin.
- comma.complete_nominal (19): the only shared modifier is עצרה 'solemn assembly, gathering', which the draft states. No piece is a function word or a fragment. Every piece is also a route on the key in מאומה, טבח and אפרת.
- comma.copula_elliptic (10): 'to be' is a route on none of the 10 keys, and no completed 'to become X' route exists.
- comma.verb_head_distributed (11): no later piece is a non-verb. The only completed piece that exists as a route is שאר 'to be left', which supports "frame written once". פעל 'work' is a route on its own, but it is the noun homograph.
- comma.list_with_edge_parenthesis (7): the only hit is טחרים, where 'tumors' and 'ulcers' are routes; the draft states it. No edge parenthesis is plainly scoped to a single piece, and none is a non-qualifier.
- comma.of_head_distributed (4): 'cave', 'pit', 'mouth of cave' and 'mouth of pit' are routes on neither key.
- The '?' series (4), '!' series (3), ':' (sorcerer: sorceress) and spaced '/' (purslane / mallows): no piece is a route on its own key, and none is a question or a label.

(d) v3 comparison matches exactly: 14,823 routes compared. 14,789 are divided the same; v3 divides 30 that the declaration keeps whole; the declaration divides 0 that v3 keeps whole; 0 are divided differently. In 2 routes (קפד, בוא) v3 prints nothing and the declaration prints the route whole; in 2 (צהב) both print nothing. Each separated route's pieces rejoin.

My scripts are verify.mjs, falsify2.mjs and unrouted-items.mjs, with outputs verify-result.json, falsify.json and falsify2.json, all in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-mashiachsonyosef-github-io/c72302ec-11e7-5b6d-a5ab-47bb077585fe/scratchpad/punct/verify/hiperbiblia_sdbh/.
corrections: Wording only; no count changes. paren.argument_placeholder: change 'holding someone/.../Y' to 'whose content contains, as a word (a trailing 's allowed), one of someone/something/somewhere/one/one's/oneself/another/X/Y'. With exact content the shape is 181 (exact-or-possessive 220), not 351, and qualifier becomes 566 instead of 396.

Wording only. q.route_final_interrogative: list the opening words the test accepts. 'Begins with an interrogative word' read as the usual wh-words gives 12 interrogative and 23 uncertainty. Reproducing 23/12 needs for what, from where, is, really and truly too; that adds 11 routes: for what purpose? x2, from where? x2, really? x2, truly? x2, is it true? x2, is there ...? x1. All 23 are questions, so the meaning holds.

State that the shape tests are first-match in their listed order. As worded, comma.verb_head_distributed ('first piece begins to , a later piece does not') also matches all 10 comma.copula_elliptic commas. Either declare the order or add 'first piece not exactly to be' to verb_head. The paren qualifier catch-all ('any other') likewise needs the named paren shapes tested first.

Meaning wording for paren.argument_placeholder, a non-dividing shape. Under the contains reading, 131 of the 351 pairs (351 - 220) hold a whole phrase with a placeholder in it rather than a bare slot: (one's wings), (one's face with a cloth), (a handful of something), (to do something), (someone with food). In משיח 'anointed (one)' the parenthesis is an optional head noun, not a slot the context fills. It is still one reading in every case, so nothing about division changes.

Observation for declared_from; it does not change the ';' meaning. Every route is an item, but 37 of 15,055 depth-0 items are a route nowhere on their key. 1 is the '-' at את, 1 is the uncut צהב item, and 35 are ordinary glosses the ingest never emitted (e.g. ים: sea, ענן: cloud, גרם: bone, מלח: salt, שמש: sun). The draft's 14,821 + 197 leaves these 37 unmentioned; 'one route per item' should note them.
falsified_meanings: No dividing shape is falsified beyond the draft's stated, counted exceptions: עצרה 'solemn assembly, gathering' (complete_nominal, 1) and טחרים '(images of) hemorrhoids, tumors, ulcers' (list_with_edge_parenthesis, 1).

One non-dividing shape: paren.argument_placeholder's 'the slot the context fills' is wrong for משיח 'anointed (one)' (1, an optional head noun). It is loose for the other phrase-content pairs counted in the corrections (131 phrase pairs in all). 'One reading' still holds.
